youtube_description:
Hannah Congdon in conversation with actresses Natalia de Molina and Greta Fernández on ‘Elisa y Marcela’.

The film captures the story of Elisa Sánchez Loriga and Marcela Gracia Ibeas, set in Spain in 1901. Isabel Coixet’s beautiful black-and-white images and genuine perfomances by Natalia de Molina and Greta Fernández masterfully renders the women's romance, a story about passion, dignity and resistance.

For more information: http://www.teddyaward.tv/en/archive/?a-z=1&select=&id_film=786
